english.note: Use this when the person's haughtiness specifically shows disregard or contempt for other people.
Use this to stress that the person treats other people as beneath notice.

examples.english: They are so haughty that they even ignore the manager when he speaks to them.
examples.traditional: 佢目中無人，連經理同佢講嘢都當聽唔到。
examples.jyutping: keoi5 muk6 zung1 mou4 jan4 lin4 ging1 lei5 tung4 keoi5 gong2 je5 dou1 dong3 teng1 m4 dou3

examples.english: After being promoted to manager, they became arrogant and acted as if their colleagues were invisible.
examples.traditional: 佢升咗做經理之後，目中無人，見到同事都當睇唔到。
examples.jyutping: keoi5 sing1 zo2 zou6 ging1 lei5 zi1 hau6 muk6 zung1 mou4 jan4 gin3 dou2 tung4 si6 dou1 dong3 tai2 m4 dou2
